correctness.rationale: The helper implements the full inspectable settle-window contract: PR-number and env validation, allow-list loading with [bot] stripping, head SHA checks before and after each GraphQL snapshot, five RESULT= branches with matching exit codes (0/0/2/3/4), and machine-readable stdout including RESULT= and HEAD=. Bats fixtures exercise CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, and API_ERROR with expected status and output assertions. GraphQL variables split owner and repo correctly (OWNER/NAME). One non-fatal gap: terminal bot detection treats any allow-listed review whose commit.oid equals the current head as terminal without checking review.state (e.g., PENDING), and pagination is capped at reviews(last:100)/reviewThreads(first:100) with no hasNextPage handling.

quality.rationale: Implementation is clear and repo-consistent: set -uo pipefail, structured emit_result helper, embedded snapshot_parser.py for testable state logic, mktemp+trap cleanup, and focused eight-file diff. Documentation is broadly synced across pr-resolve-all.md (helper preference plus preserved time-based fallback), AI_REPO_GUIDE.md, and scripts/README.md; bot-allowlist.txt is well commented. Minor deduction: pr-resolve-all.md still lists only two bot bullets in prose while scripts/lib/bot-allowlist.txt defines seven entries, and the inline Python parser is not unit-tested separately despite the extractability comment.

process.rationale: Diff stays focused on the helper, allow-list, bats tests, check wiring, and required doc/prompt companions with no AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, or live-state churn; objective process scored 15/15 and doc_companions passed 2/2. pr-resolve-all.md prefers the helper, documents per-RESULT handling and SHA restart behavior, preserves the documented time-based fallback, and renumbers round disciplines consistently.

reliability.rationale: scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats adds five mock-gh scenario tests covering all documented exit paths including TIMEOUT; scripts/checks/141-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh wires run_bats_check and scripts/checks/105-scripts.sh includes the helper for syntax lint. Objective evidence shows bash_n_poll_helper and lint_poll_helper passed and test_wiring matched 2/2, but bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped in this bundle with no runtime transcript, and bats omit precondition cases (missing/empty allow-list, gh missing) plus standalone parser tests.

uncertainty_notes: bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped in objective-grade.json; mock-based contract tests are structurally credible from the diff but not runtime-verified in this bundle.
Whether counting PENDING reviews with commit.oid equal to head as terminal is intended is not fully specified; immediate CONVERGED when zero allow-listed bots participate is plausible but untested.

emit_result maps CONVERGED and QUIET_ELAPSED to exit 0, TIMEOUT to 2, SHA_CHANGED to 3, and API_ERROR to 4 while printing RESULT= and HEAD= fields.
Poll loop reads head before snapshot, fetches GraphQL state with -F owner=$OWNER -F repo=$NAME, compares snap_head and head_after to EXPECTED_HEAD, and exits SHA_CHANGED when they differ.
snapshot_parser.py sets CONVERGED when unresolved==0 and (participating==0 or terminal>=participating), marking terminal via review commit.oid==head_sha without review.state checks.
GraphQL query limits reviews to last:100 and reviewThreads to first:100 with no pagination continuation.
pr-resolve-all.md adds settle-window helper invocation, per-RESULT handling, canonical allow-list pointer, and preserves QUIET_WINDOW sleep fallback on API_ERROR or missing helper.
